description: Strict keyword-unit subset with three explicit leader implementations.

cards.title: Sabine Wren
cards.subtitle: Galvanized Revolutionary
cards.text: Action [exhaust]: Deal 1 damage to each base.
cards.deployBox: On Attack: Deal 1 damage to each enemy base.
cards.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 4 or more resources, deploy this leader.
cards.reason: Explicitly implemented leader and deployed side.

cards.title: Darth Vader
cards.subtitle: Don't Fail Me Again
cards.text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Deal 1 damage to a base.
cards.deployBox: On Attack: Deal 2 damage to a base.
cards.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader. (Flip him, ready him, and move him to the ground arena.)
cards.reason: Explicitly implemented leader and deployed side.

cards.title: Satine Kryze
cards.subtitle: Standing on Principles
cards.text: Action [Exhaust]: Heal up to 2 damage from a unit. If you do, deal that much damage to your base.
cards.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
cards.rules: You can use Satine's leader ability and choose to heal 0 damage from a unit, but if you do, you are not considered to have healed any damage.
cards.reason: Explicitly implemented leader and deployed side.

cards.title: Cartel Heavy Fighter
cards.text: Overwhelm (When attacking an enemy unit, deal excess damage to the opponent's base.)
cards.rules:
Shields prevent all damage from a unit with Overwhelm. There is no excess damage since the defender is not defeated.
If the defender is defeated during an attack before combat damage is dealt, all combat damage is considered excess damage for Overwhelm.
